meta.title: DSH Memories
meta.description: Personal memory for DSH: every new session starts with a how-to-use-your-memories guide plus a global long-term index, a global short-term note, and a workspace memory index, each injected whole and composed read-only from memory files carrying a one-line Description; scripts/generate-index.mjs regenerates the current workspace's INDEX.md on demand and the plugin never writes it; the /memory command and the agent memory tool write and preview memories; the Memories right-sidebar tab lists all memories and shows each one's full content on a detail page, scoped to the current session's workspace.
